text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I check my emails and plan the day ahead. I begin work at nine and follow a steady schedule, with a short break for lunch around noon. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either jogging or doing yoga at home. In the evening, I cook dinner, relax with a book, and go to bed early. I believe consistency is the key to a balanced and productive life.
